title: Santa Fe Trail
description: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: Fast Bullets
description: Two Texas Rangers (Tom Tyler, Rex Lease) nab smugglers and rescue a woman (Margaret Nearing) from a runaway wagon.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E21 — Pancho Held Hostage
Cisco and Pancho capture a notorious bank robber after falling for a trap set by the criminal's sister.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E22 — Freight Line Feud
Cisco and Pancho attempt to convince a freighting company owner that her competitor did not steal from her wagons.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E23 — Phony Sheriff
A phony sheriff is part of a rustling scheme.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E24 — Uncle Disinherits Niece
Cisco and Pancho discover the shady motives of a lawyer hired to change a rancher's will.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E07 — Sam Bass
Frankie befriends an outlaw after his gang robs the train.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E08 — Johnny Ringo
While investigating a train robbery, Matt Clark learns about Johnny Ringo; Frankie gets a job doing undercover work; Matt tracks Johnny down.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E09 — The Dalton Gang
Former deputies plan on robbing a gold shipment after their brother is killed.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
Doc Holiday
Detective Matt Clark and his partner Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to find Doc Holliday with suspicion that Holliday is involved in the gang activity there; starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E18 — Stubborn Pioneer
Carpenter heads into the wilderness to establish a new settlement; Hawkeye and Chingachgook try to prevent disaster.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E19 — The Promised Valley
A Tuscarawas brave tries to start a war between his people and the white men.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E20 — The Girl
A young woman with a past and a Seneca Chief attempt to stir the Iroquois into war with the settlers.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E21 — The Soldier
A young soldier is accused of stealing new breech-loading rifles and selling them to the Indians; he is being tried for treason unless Hawkeye can discover the truth.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E22 — Huron Tomahawk
Mike is returning home to marry but his fiancé and family have been murdered in what appears to be a Huron raid.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E23 — Tolliver Gang
Tolliver and his outlaw gang of former pirates have kidnapped two women and demanded a ransom of 1000 pounds; Hawkeye infiltrates the gang in an attempt to get them back.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E24 — The Colonel and His Lady
Chief Black Wolf and his tribe are accused of breaking the treaty; it is up to Hawkeye and Chingachgook to clear them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E25 — Washington Story
Surveyor George Washington aids a young woman whose land grant is threatened by a wicked innkeeper.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Under Western Stars
description: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Daughter of the West
description: A convent-raised woman (Martha Vickers) learns of her American Indian heritage through romance with an educated Navajo (Philip Reed) during the 1880s.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Colorado Sundown
description: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

title: Tulsa
description: A cattle rancher's daughter (Susan Hayward) turns Oklahoma wildcatter with a geologist (Robert Preston) and an Indian (Pedro Armendáriz) as partners.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: Six-Gun Trail
description: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: The Lawless Frontier
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) protects a girl (Sheila Terry) and her father (George Hayes) from a rustler and a sheriff.

title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
description: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

title: The Light of Western Stars
description: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: Rawhide Rangers
description: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Leather Burners
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) helps his friend Johnny (Jay Kirby) find out where rustlers are hiding stolen cattle.

title: Hands Across the Border
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: Rawhide
description: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: The Dawn Rider
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

title: The Outlaw
description: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.
